title: ""
page-layout: full
filters:
  - lightbox
lightbox: auto
freeze: auto
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          #quarto-content.page-columns {
            display: block !important;
          }

          #quarto-content,
          .quarto-container,
          main,
          main.content,
          #quarto-document-content {
            max-width: 100% !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }

          /* Style <summary> to look like .scroll-card, remove default marker */
          .fieldwork-toggle summary.scroll-card {
            cursor: pointer;
            list-style: none;
          }
          .fieldwork-toggle summary.scroll-card::-webkit-details-marker {
            display: none;
          }
          .fieldwork-toggle summary.scroll-card::marker {
            content: "";
          }

          /* Down-arrow that flips when open, instead of scroll-card's default → */
          .fieldwork-toggle .scroll-card-cta::after {
            content: '↓';
          }
          .fieldwork-toggle[open] .scroll-card-cta::after {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
          }

          .fieldwork-gallery-wrap {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 2.5rem 2rem 4rem;
          }

          /* Stagger alternating covers, since each summary.scroll-card
             is nested inside its own <details> and can't use the
             shared :nth-child(even) rule directly */
          .fieldwork-toggle:nth-of-type(even) summary.scroll-card .scroll-card-img {
            order: 2;
          }
          .fieldwork-toggle:nth-of-type(even) summary.scroll-card .scroll-card-body {
            order: 1;
          }
        </style>
---
